say:1:1110214001:1.text: Greetings! How can I help you?
say:1:1110214001:1.source_cn: 欢迎欢迎！几位要来点什么？

say:2:1110214002:1.text: It's strange to find the Adamant Syndicate here in the Ashen Wastes.
say:2:1110214002:1.source_cn: 你们黑金商会的商人居然来了荒角沙漠，真是奇怪。

say:3:1110214003:1.text: The Warsong Festival is a grand event for the Mauler clans. Wherever there are customers, there is money to be made!
say:3:1110214003:1.source_cn: 战歌节可是蛮血的盛会，有人的地方，就有钱赚！

say:4:1110214004:1.text: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.
say:4:1110214004:1.source_cn: 只跟您说，我来这一趟确实赚头不小！既然您知道我们黑金商...
say:4:1110214004:1.male: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.
say:4:1110214004:1.female: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.

say:5:1110214005:1.text: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
say:5:1110214005:1.source_cn: 这桌上的特色商品，有没有能入眼的？
say:5:1110214005:1.male: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
say:5:1110214005:1.female: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?

choice_prompt:6:1110214005.text: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.source_cn: 这桌上的特色商品，有没有能入眼的？
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.male: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.female: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?

say:7:1110214006:1.text: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.
say:7:1110214006:1.source_cn: 也是，这可是耀光来的货物，本地蛮血更喜欢。您自然见惯了。
say:7:1110214006:1.male: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.
say:7:1110214006:1.female: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.

say:8:1110214007:1.text: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!
say:8:1110214007:1.source_cn: 不过没关系，您要是有别的需求，随时来看！
say:8:1110214007:1.male: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!
say:8:1110214007:1.female: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!
